integrity: Original primary-paper stationary/first-passage and general spectral formulas are credited; analytic finite-size calculation and accompanying numerical checks are separately identified. Independent external evaluation has not been performed.
limitations: Fixed positive refresh time and initial site, absorbing left boundary and suppressed-outward-attempt reflecting right boundary, independent fresh rates with Laplace transform (1+s^alpha)^-1; no general rate-law universality or joint growing-start limits.
title: Finite-size rounding of a fluctuating-rate first-passage transition
